title: The graph map of a 1-Lipschitz function is sqrt(2)-Lipschitz
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, q a linear isometry of ℝ^{n+ℓ}, f : ℝ^n → ℝ^ℓ and D ⊆ ℝ^n, and assume f is 1-Lipschitz on D. Write F(x) := q(graphPoint x (f x)). Then (a) ‖F(x) − F(x')‖ ≤ √2 ‖x − x'‖ for all x, x' ∈ D; and (b) if f(0) = 0 and 0 ∈ D, then ‖F(x)‖ ≤ √2 ‖x‖ for every x ∈ D.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (D : Set (Rn n)), LipschitzOnWith 1 f D → (∀ x ∈ D, ∀ x' ∈ D, ‖q (graphPoint x (f x)) - q (graphPoint x' (f x'))‖ ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * ‖x - x'‖) ∧ (f 0 = 0 → (0 : Rn n) ∈ D → ∀ x ∈ D, ‖q (graphPoint x (f x))‖ ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * ‖x‖)
